text: United Nations Secretary-General António Guterres welcomed the announcement by the United States to extend the ceasefire, saying it is an important step toward de-escalation and creating critical space for diplomacy and confidence-building between Iran and the United States.
translated_text: 联合国秘书长安东尼奥·古特雷斯对美国宣布延长停火表示欢迎，称这是缓和紧张局势并为伊朗与美国之间的外交和建立信任创造关键空间的重要一步。

text: A new lawsuit alleges that Meta, the parent company of Facebook and Instagram, failed to block ads that could pose a risk to users while charging those advertisers more to display their content.
translated_text: 一项新的诉讼称，Facebook 和 Instagram 的母公司 Meta 未能屏蔽可能对用户构成风险的广告，同时向这些广告商收取更多展示其内容的费用。

text: Pakistan's efforts until the last moment... The ceasefire has been extended, but trust between Iran and the US has not been established. Efforts must continue because war is dangerous not just for both parties but for the entire world.
translated_text: 巴基斯坦直到最后一刻的努力……停火已经延长，但伊朗和美国之间的信任尚未建立。必须继续努力，因为战争不仅对双方而且对整个世界都是危险的。

text: New details on the gunman at Mexico’s Teotihuacán pyramids reveal he carried a backpack filled with ammunition, knives, gloves, and goggles when he opened fire, killing a Canadian tourist and injuring at least 13 others.
translated_text: 墨西哥特奥蒂瓦坎金字塔枪手的最新细节显示，他开枪时背负着一个装满弹药、刀具、手套和护目镜的背包，导致一名加拿大游客死亡，并造成至少 13 人受伤。
